src.title: The TASTIEST High Protein Breakfast Crunch Wraps

recipes.title: High-Protein Breakfast Crunchwraps

items.i: hash brown patties (about 46 g each), air-fried
low-fat shredded cheese (25 g per wrap)

steps: Mix the beef with the taco seasoning until it changes color.
Put a ball of beef on each mini tortilla and squash it flat to the edges.
Cook meat side down in a pan until crispy, flip, add a cheese slice and cover to melt. Repeat for all six.
In the same pan, scramble the eggs over low heat until light and fluffy.
Mix the ketchup, mayo and yogurt until smooth.
On each large tortilla: a sixth of the sauce, a crispy hash brown (broken up), eggs, chives, 25 g cheese, then a beef tortilla beef-side down.
Fold the sides in around the beef tortilla to make a crunchwrap and toast seam-side down in a pan until crispy on both sides.
Wrap in foil and freeze; reheat when you want one.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the on-screen captions; 575 cal and 54 g protein per crunchwrap are from the video title. Carbs and fat are estimates.
